content: Tawil and Hameln. I know they work well together but I don’t know why or hope to properly do them. I am trying to do a Tawil and Hameln team with two Aequor characters. At the moment it’s Murphy:Fauxborn and Celeste.

I generally don't give pull advice as it varies wildly player to player (different playstyles, horizontal vs vertical investment, faves vs meta), so my advice will be very different to what another player would suggest, while both/neither can reflect what's truly best for YOU! <3

With that in mind; I encourage testing out the Wanda + Caecus combo first and find out if you like that playstyle!! Winkle has excellent counter synergy with them and comes in clutch to force an exalt when you need it, plus extra weakness, can discard symptom cards and the only character to remove barriers (also if you end up pulling/playing Vortice, she allows her to use pursuit more often too!) 

However from standards, Goliath is the only character with strength-steal (which is amazing vs bosses with 500+ strength) and Celeste has a free built-in revive, powerful healing and purifies stagnant/sluggish (which is the current bane in dzone and arc2 ch6), both are aequor though, so if you enjoy caro more, that recommendation won't mean much! There's also Tinct and Casiah but as I don't personally use them, I can't advocate for them as strongly as someone who does enjoy or relies on them!

Counter can be very fun vs multi-hit enemies while Wanda doubles + lowers their attack, so you can get scenarios like this of dealing 1mil counter damage! But if that playstyle feels too slow and you'd rather insta-nuke with 2mil active damage instead, it's all up to what you prefer! 

Sorry for another wordy reply omg, but rest assured that you will eventually unlock all characters and you can't "brick" an account either, so pull whoever you feel most drawn to!!<:Pandia_love:1459078512303411261>

content:
Gotcha, that is a good synergy combo! Hameln gives extra arithmetica which is important for burst turns that require lots of cards played, he can also force a card to be played twice which is VERY important for Tawil (this makes her four wings and six wings play twice! or play 3 times when paired with her own exalt)

Both of them are chorus too which means it's a base 30 keyflare instead of 15, meaning both can output huge keyflare regen, so Tawil will be able to play her wing cards via keyflare energy when you're out of arithmetica! 

GMurphy has great synergy with them too as they can make her waltz play 3x for high damage! Then Celeste is a great healer and support, plus her overexalt creates 3x tintless dreams, giving 3 bonus arithmetica on top of healing to play more cards

Sounds like a very solid and powerful team, the only thing to keep in mind is tentacle cooldown and planning your burst turns!<:Celeste_pray:1356053116260454534>
